build_dinov2_tokenizer: build a DinoV2 image tokenizer module to extract visual tokens from image snippets
create_tokenizer_with_linear_projection: create an ImageToDinoV2Tokens instance with a linear projection layer to map features to a custom output dimension
run_forward_on_image_snippet: run the forward pass on a BxTxCxHxW image tensor to get DinoV2 token features
test_post_process_feature_rearrange: test the post_process method to resize, rotate, and rearrange DinoV2 feature maps into token sequences
review_forward_resize_patch_alignment: review the forward_resize method that rounds up image dimensions to the nearest multiple of 14 for DinoV2 patch compatibility
